offering_description.value: Herc rents construction and industrial equipment to contractors, facility operators, government agencies and individual customers. It operates a branch-based rental fleet that includes aerial lifts, earthmoving machinery and specialty equipment, and it sells used fleet equipment.

primary_products.value: used rental equipment; new equipment; replacement parts; contractor supplies

primary_services.value: equipment rental; equipment delivery and pickup; temporary power and climate control setup; equipment maintenance and repair; operator safety training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Construction contractors, industrial plants, utilities and commercial facility operators; B2G: Government agencies and municipal public works departments; B2C: Homeowners and other individual renters

end_markets.value: commercial and residential construction; infrastructure and utilities; industrial manufacturing; oil and gas; facilities maintenance

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Temporary use of general and specialty equipment; product sales: Used fleet equipment, new equipment, replacement parts and contractor supplies; service fees: Equipment delivery, pickup and repair
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Buys and maintains equipment fleets for rental to contractors, facility operators and public agencies; service provider: Uses its fleet and technicians to provide temporary power, climate control and equipment support to job sites

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: General construction equipment and specialty fleets for temporary power, climate control, pumping and trench safety

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated equipment rental branches; direct sales: Field sales representatives and national account teams; online: Company website and customer portal for rental requests and account management

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Workplace and equipment safety, commercial fleet transport, and fuel handling under OSHA, DOT and environmental rules
